mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_comment (post_id, user_id, parent_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.deleted, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM post_comment c JOIN `user` u ON u.id = c.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time ASC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comment WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND deleted = 0
